versions.statuteQuote: No landlord may demand or receive a security deposit, however denominated, in an amount or value in excess of two months' periodic rent.

summaryForModel: A security deposit, whatever it is called, cannot exceed two months' rent.
paraphraseExamples: Tenant shall deliver a security deposit equal to three months' rent.
A refundable damage deposit of $4,000 is due at signing (monthly rent $1,500).
tenantExplanation: Virginia limits a security deposit to two months' rent. A landlord can't ask for more.
action: You can ask your landlord to lower the deposit to two months' rent or less.
